title: 第5章 想装逼强制打断第6章 神子亲临
slug: 反派神子开局送主角九族消消乐
content_zh:
随着叶不凡与李靠背两人接近太衍圣地，远远便看到山门前聚集了不少人，气氛异常热烈，仿佛早已等候多时。
众人目光齐齐投来。
其中不少人很快认出了叶不凡。
荒山界东域，关于他的传言早已传开。
当初，三年之约被许多人视为笑谈。
却没想到，这三年间叶不凡独自在外，竟是闯出一番名声，现如今更是受得靠山宗宗主器重，成为其真传弟子。
叫人艳羡！
于是三年之约再次成为众人热议的话题，今日不少人跑来太衍圣地山门，显然是为了目睹这一场好戏！
“快看！
是叶不凡来了！”
“好戏开场！
诸位，我乃万域商会王家分脉，当初听闻三年之约一事，王某颇为佩服叶少侠气魄，今日由我坐庄……来来来都来下注，叶不凡赔率1:1.5，云家圣女1:2…”
“我下注叶不凡！”
“我也下注！”
叶不凡与李靠背见状微微一愣，倒是没想到会是这般场景。
见此，叶不凡嘴角咧出一抹夸张的弧度！
何曾几时，他也能享受到这般待遇？
被人簇拥、被人瞩目…
这种感觉，真是让人不禁有些陶醉！
他右脚踏出沉稳一步，对着山门前喊道：“我乃靠山宗真传弟子叶不凡！

今日来此，便是为当初三年之…”
啪！
一阵巨响，叶不凡被一股强大的力量拍飞，整个人横扫数米，重重摔倒在地。
只见场中出现一名男子。
他戴着青面獠牙面具，黑袍的胸前绣着鎏金色“天卫”
二字。
他目光戏谑地扫向叶不凡，调笑般地说道：“哎呀，知道了知道了，你吼得那么大声干嘛？”
叶不凡猛地从地上爬起，右脸上印着一道鲜红的巴掌印，鼻口眼部血迹斑斑。
整张脸被打得歪斜，像个猪头。
怒火在他胸中翻腾，几乎要喷发出来。
“谁？你是谁！
？”
他怒吼着。
然而当他目光扫过四周，那名男子早已消失得无影无踪。
一旁的李靠背也是呆愣住了。
想他堂堂一位真王境强者，竟未察觉到对方是如何出手的？
转眼间又消失不见…
他心中一阵惊恐。
这意味着那个男子的修为，远超自己！
而叶不凡则像被气血攻心的疯狗般，狂躁不已，四处大喊：“刚刚是谁出手打我？有本事出来，敢做不敢认吗？”

“出来！
！”
一旁的众人见状也是惊呆了，不知道发生神魔事了。
content_en:
As Ye Bufan and Li Leibei approached Taiyan Holy Land, they saw many people gathered in front of the mountain gate from a distance. The atmosphere was extremely warm, as if they had been waiting for a long time.
Everyone's eyes turned to him.
Many of them quickly recognized Ye Bufan.
Rumors about him have long spread in the eastern region of the Barren Mountain Realm.
At first, the three-year agreement was regarded as a joke by many people.
Unexpectedly, in the past three years, Ye Bufan had made a name for himself while out on his own, and now he was highly regarded by the patron sect master and became his true disciple.
It’s enviable!
So the three-year agreement once again became a hot topic among everyone. Today, many people came to the mountain gate of Taiyan Holy Land, obviously to witness this wonderful show!
"Look!
It's Ye Bufan here! "
"The show is about to begin!
Everyone, I am a branch of the Wang family of the Wanyu Chamber of Commerce. When I first heard about the three-year agreement, Wang admired Ye Shaoxia's courage. Today, I will be the banker... Come and place your bets. Ye Bufan's odds are 1:1.5, and the Yun family's saintess is 1:2..."
"I'll bet on Ye Bufan!"
"I'll bet too!"
Ye Bufan and Li Bianbei were slightly startled when they saw this, but they did not expect such a scene.
Seeing this, Ye Bufan grinned with an exaggerated arc!
How long had he been able to enjoy such treatment?
Being surrounded by others and being noticed...
This feeling is really intoxicating!
He took a steady step with his right foot and shouted in front of the mountain gate: "I am Ye Bufan, the true disciple of the Mountain Sect!
Coming here today is to pay tribute to those three years ago..."
Snap!
There was a loud noise, and Ye Bufan was knocked away by a powerful force. He swept several meters across and fell heavily to the ground.
I saw a man appear in the field.
He wears a green-faced fang mask, and has the word "Heavenly Guard" embroidered in gold on the chest of his black robe.
Two words.
He glanced at Ye Bufan playfully and said teasingly: "Oh, I know, I know, why are you shouting so loudly?"
Ye Bufan suddenly got up from the ground, with a bright red slap mark on his right face, and blood stains on his nose, mouth and eyes.
The whole face was beaten crookedly, like a pig's head.
Anger boiled in his chest, almost bursting out.
"Who? Who are you!
? "
he roared.
However, when he glanced around, the man had already disappeared without a trace.
Li Bianbei on the side was also stunned.
To think that he, a powerful man in the true king realm, didn't realize how the other party took action?
Disappeared again in the blink of an eye...
There was a panic in his heart.
This means that the man's cultivation far exceeds his own!
Ye Bufan, on the other hand, was like a mad dog driven by blood and rage, shouting everywhere: "Who just hit me? If you have the ability, do you dare to do it but not admit it?"
"Come out!
! "
Everyone on the side was shocked when they saw this, not knowing that something divine or demonic had happened.
